name: Sum of Absolute Differences (SAD)
definition: A regularization prior defined as the sum of absolute differences between a voxel and all voxels in its 3x3 neighborhood (excluding itself). It is an extension of ATV considering more edges per voxel.
summary: Sum of Absolute Differences is a regularization prior that enforces stronger local smoothing than Anisotropic Total Variation by summing absolute differences across a full 3x3 spatial neighborhood.
